verdict.rationale: Google's docs explicitly state users can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs to get 'answers, summaries, and insights' (gemini-docs-25), and this is corroborated by real-world hands-on evidence of high accuracy processing PDFs (96% accuracy vs. a dedicated OCR vendor, gemini-comm-17) and strong performance analyzing large document corpuses in NotebookLM (gemini-comm-19) and large codebases (gemini-comm-13). Missing for 10: no specific evidence of spreadsheet-analysis accuracy, and one community report notes inaccuracies in a related visual-extraction task (bounding boxes, gemini-comm-18) suggesting imperfect precision on some content types.
